meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理消息频道与智能体组的连接：查看当前配置、添加新频道、调整频道归属、设置隔离级别，并显示所有频道和用户权限。
howto.when: 当你需要配置或调整消息频道（如 Telegram、Slack）与智能体组的关联时触发。通常在添加新频道后、初始设置期间或单独重新配置时使用。

say.text: 帮我查看当前频道和智能体组的连接情况。
say.note: Claude 会读取数据库并展示配置摘要。

say.text: 把 Slack 频道 #general 连接到客服智能体组。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成隔离级别选择和注册命令。

say.text: 添加一个新的 Telegram 群组并连接到现有智能体。
say.note: Claude 会询问隔离意图并执行配对流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage the connection between messaging channels and agent groups: view current configuration, add new channels, reassign channels, set isolation levels, and display all channels and user privileges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure or adjust the association between messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack) and agent groups. Typically used after adding a new channel, during initial setup, or standalone for reconfiguration.

say_en.text: Show me the current channel and agent group connections.
say_en.note: Claude reads the database and displays a configuration summary.

say_en.text: Connect the Slack channel #general to the customer support agent group.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through isolation level selection and registration command.

say_en.text: Add a new Telegram group and connect it to an existing agent.
say_en.note: Claude asks for isolation intent and runs the pairing flow.
